name: mem-watchdog-status
description: Prevents VS Code from being OOM-killed on ChromeOS Crostini — auto-installs a systemd memory watchdog daemon that kills Chrome/Playwright before the kernel kills VS Code.

commands.title: Optimize VS Code for Low Memory

memWatchdog.sigtermThresholdPct.markdownDescription: Send `SIGTERM` to Chrome/Playwright when `MemAvailable` drops below this % of total RAM. Default: `25` (~1.6 GB on a 6.3 GB system).

memWatchdog.sigkillThresholdPct.markdownDescription: Escalate to `SIGKILL` when `MemAvailable` drops below this %. Must be less than `#memWatchdog.sigtermThresholdPct#`. Default: `15` (~945 MB).

memWatchdog.psiThresholdPct.markdownDescription: Send `SIGTERM` on sustained memory stall: PSI `full avg10` exceeds this %. Default: `25`.

memWatchdog.vscodeRssWarnMB.markdownDescription: Warn threshold for aggregate VS Code RSS in MB. Used by the status UI, chat rescue guard, and daemon circuit-breaker config. Default: `3400`.

memWatchdog.vscodeRssEmergencyMB.markdownDescription: Emergency threshold for aggregate VS Code RSS in MB. Must be greater than `#memWatchdog.vscodeRssWarnMB#`. Default: `3800`.

memWatchdog.chatGuard.enabled.markdownDescription: Enable the Chat Continuity Guard, which detects oversized Copilot chat sessions, offers archival with a continuity pack, and can reload VS Code before the extension host re-parses the oversized session JSON.

memWatchdog.chatGuard.sessionSizeMB.markdownDescription: Prompt for rescue when a recent Copilot chat session JSON reaches this size in MB. Default: `120`.

memWatchdog.chatGuard.autoRescue.markdownDescription: Behavior when Chat Continuity Guard detects a dangerous oversized session. `off` disables prompting, `prompt` offers rescue, `auto` archives and reloads automatically. Default: `prompt`.

memWatchdog.chatGuard.restartAfterRescue.markdownDescription: Reload VS Code automatically after a successful chat rescue so the extension host does not immediately re-parse the oversized archived session.

memWatchdog.chatGuard.preserveCount.markdownDescription: How many rescue archives to keep in `~/.config/mem-watchdog/chat-archives/`. Older rescue bundles are pruned after a new rescue.

memWatchdog.interactiveKillApproval.enab.markdownDescription: When true, non-critical disposable-process kills request operator approval through a VS Code modal before Mem Watchdog intervenes. Critical emergency paths are never blocked.

memWatchdog.interactiveKillApproval.defe.markdownDescription: How long to hold fire after choosing defer in the interactive kill-approval modal. Default: `120` seconds.
